name: Caps
summary: Your Claude and Codex limits, on the shelf
description: Caps shows how much of your Claude and Codex limits you have used. Codex is read from its own session logs on your Mac, for any number of Codex folders. Claude is opt-in: switch it on in settings and Caps reads the Claude Code login already saved on your Mac and sends one usage request to Anthropic per refresh, from your Mac. A shelf card gives each account its 7-day use, 5-hour use and reset times, with a total as a small ring beside the notch. A short banner drops from the notch when an account runs out or comes back, or a 5-hour window runs high. Name each account, switch any off, and set the refresh rate and alert levels in settings. Advanced: point Caps at a snapshot file to show accounts from another tool.
